## Course Information

- **Course Title:** Thermal Power Plant Simulator
- **Term:** Winter 2027
- **Schedule:** 4 periods per week, \[Insert date\] to \[Insert date\]
- **Credits:** \[Insert credits\]
- **Prerequisites:** Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics

## Learning Objectives

Students will be able to: 1. Simulate steady-state and transient operation of thermal power plants. 2. Analyze the performance of boilers, turbines, condensers, and feedwater systems. 3. Optimize plant efficiency and evaluate environmental performance.

## Assessment

| Component              | Weight |
|------------------------|--------|
| Laboratory Simulations | 40%    |
| Assignments            | 25%    |
| Midterm Examination    | 15%    |
| Final Project          | 20%    |

## Policies

- All simulation reports must be submitted through the course platform.
- Late submissions will result in a 5% deduction for each day past the submission deadline.
- Academic integrity policies will be strictly enforced.
